title: Pipeline Definition
description: Full pipeline definition including metadata, infrastructure configuration, and step definitions. This YAML file is the single source of truth for a pipeline — environment-specific values (VPC, subnets) remain in tfvars.

pipeline_name.description: Unique name for this pipeline. Used in resource naming across S3, Step Functions, Batch, etc.

buckets.description: S3 bucket types to create. 'intermediate' is always required.

tags.description: Tags to apply to all pipeline resources.

pipeline_completion_emails.description: Email addresses to notify on pipeline completion.

capacity_provider.description: Batch compute capacity provider. Use 'FARGATE' for on-demand or 'FARGATE_SPOT' for cost-optimized spot instances.

max_concurrency.description: Maximum concurrency for the parallel Map step. 0 means unlimited.

cw_retention_days.description: CloudWatch Logs retention in days. Must be between 15 and 730 (matches the module's OpenTofu validation).

ssm_parameters.description: SSM parameter names to create as placeholders under /pipelines/<pipeline_name>-<env>/params/<name>.

secrets.description: Secrets Manager secrets to create as placeholders.

name.description: Unique name. Only alphanumeric and underscores allowed (no hyphens). Result stored at $.<name>_result automatically.

ecr_repository_url.description: External ECR URL. Omit to auto-create.

runtime_parameters.description: Key-value pairs passed as env vars from execution input

name.description: Unique name. Only alphanumeric and underscores allowed (no hyphens). Result stored at $.<name>_result automatically.

runtime_parameters.description: Key-value pairs passed as payload fields from execution input

name.description: Unique name. Only alphanumeric and underscores allowed (no hyphens). Map results stored at $.<name>_result automatically.

type.description: Step type: Map block that fans out over an array

input.description: Input configuration for the parallel block. Determines how the fan-out array is resolved.

type.description: Input type: 's3' for S3 directory discovery, 'custom' for passthrough values from execution payload or a previous step's output.

from_step.description: Name of a preceding compute step whose output provides the fan-out data. When omitted and the parallel block is not the first step, defaults to the last preceding compute step's intermediate output.

root_prefix.description: S3 prefix to discover directories under. Required when the parallel block is the first step (type=s3, no from_step). With from_step, defaults to <execution_id>/<from_step>/.

field.description: Dot-notation field path within the previous step's output that holds the array (type=custom with from_step). The referenced step must be a lambda step.

parallel_steps.description: Compute steps to run inside the Map.
